cadence: Weekly news picks, refreshed every Monday alongside citation rankings.
selection: The top stories from the trailing 30 days, scored on publisher authority, discussion volume, whether a concrete verifiable result is reported, whether it changes what agent builders do now, whether an artifact was released, and expected durability. Only primary sources are cited, and performance claims remain attributed to their publishers.

items.title: CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?
items.why: The authors release a five-domain benchmark in which AI researchers jointly revise a target model and its harness within 24 hours. Their strongest researcher closes over four fifths of the gap to an instruction-tuned reference, but repeated feedback rarely sustains progress on long-horizon coding.

items.title: Language Model Harnesses can be Compositional Generalizers
items.why: The authors train recursive harnesses on shorter and synthetic surrogate tasks, reporting generalization to tasks 2–64 times longer. In the same harness, RLM-27B raises an eight-task average from 46.1 to 58.5 with about half as many inference tokens; this does not establish lower wall-clock or training cost.

items.title: Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology
items.why: The authors jointly learn Transformer weights and sublayer gates, removing unused components during pretraining. Across 140M–2.7B models, they report lower validation loss than dense models trained with up to 1.7 times more compute, up to 34% fewer FLOPs per token and up to 1.6 times faster decoding.

items.title: Sage-Evolve-Preview:Adaptive Observation for Post-Training Self-Improvement
items.why: The authors adapt diagnostic granularity, task difficulty and related observations while keeping each evaluation anchor fixed. Across eight separately optimized anchors, they report a mean increase from 66.4 to 73.7 under matched data budgets; broader domains and joint training remain untested.

items.title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
items.why: The authors release 0.8B–27B decision models developed through agent-driven data curation and model experiments. They report a 75.59 Decision Index Vision Full score for Piccolo-27B, while showing that falling training loss and longer training on fixed data can hide cross-task regressions.

items.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.why: OpenAI releases its new frontier and efficient models in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API. It reports Astra gains of 5.2 points on Agents’ Last Exam and 9 points on Terminal-Bench-Science versus GPT-6 Astra, at less than one third of the benchmark task cost.

items.title: Qwen4-Max: Your new teammate has arrived
items.why: Alibaba releases its 2.4T-parameter multimodal flagship with a 1M-token context window. On its proprietary Work360 benchmark, Alibaba reports 35% fewer tokens and about 60% lower cost per task than Qwen3.8-Max at High effort.

items.title: CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First
items.why: The authors report correct kernels for all 235 SOL-ExecBench problems and 4.40× reference speed on the 209 public-board problems on B200. A controller searches over external kernel archives; independent executable checks establish correctness, and reliable measurement throughput limits parallel scaling.

items.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.why: Google introduces a fast execution model for coding and agentic workflows, reporting 57% on Terminal-Bench 4.1 and 2.5× faster task completion than Gemini 3.8 Flash at high thinking. It brings Gemini 4 to API, AI Studio, app and Search users; availability updates do not reset the launch date.

items.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
items.why: Anthropic reports 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0 and 74.6% on Terminal-Bench-Science for Fable 5.2, plus a 30-hour formalization of Fermat’s Last Theorem. Fable is broadly available with cyber/bio safeguards; Mythos, the same underlying model with different safeguards, requires verified access.
